item.title: Who is Dr. Heidi Overton, Trump's FDA nominee?
item.description: Dr. Heidi Overton, currently a White House policy aide, would oversee an agency of 18,000 staffers if confirmed as FDA chief.

item.title: Iran conflict and tariffs hurt farmers; could it sway November vote?
item.description: In tight midterm races, farmers' frustration over the war and rising costs may influence their votes.

item.title: U.S. national debt exceeds $40 trillion, and a new census report touted by Trump draws scrutiny
item.description: The U.S. national debt has crossed the $40 trillion mark. Additionally, a census report on noncitizen voting promoted by President Trump is linked to a think tank with potential biases.

item.title: D.C. IndyCar race to pass museums, raising concerns about potential art damage
item.description: Sunday's race route takes high-speed cars near the National Gallery of Art and three Smithsonian museums, prompting worries about the safety of artworks inside.
